e5004a271929.title: Principal Engineer (MERN)
e5004a271929.description:
**Design it, build it, and own it in production.**

Anyone can draw a system diagram. What sets great architects apart is what happens after: whether the design holds when traffic grows tenfold, whether security survives a real audit, and whether teams can still build on it two years later.

Techdome designs and runs production-grade platforms in FinTech, Healthcare, AI, SaaS, and more, including our own products **JustInterview.ai** (AI hiring) and **Sparrow** (API testing). Our systems handle sensitive patient data and real financial transactions at scale. We’re looking for a hands-on Software Architect to shape how these platforms are built, write code alongside the team, and stay accountable for how they perform in production.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Own the architecture:** System design, APIs, data models, security, scalability, observability, and cloud cost.
* **Build security in:** Design PHI and payment flows with compliance part of the architecture, not a retrofit.
* **Drive cloud-native delivery:** MERN platforms on AWS/GCP/Azure with Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC, and secrets management.
* **Make the hard calls:** Monolith vs. microservices, event-driven design, integrations, build vs. buy. Decide, document, and stand behind it.
* **Own reliability:** Uptime, latency, and throughput as usage grows; lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
* **Set the standard:** Reference architectures, reusable patterns, and practical engineering guidelines.
* **Stay hands-on:** Write code, run design reviews, and review PRs every week.
* **Think like the client:** Translate business goals and constraints into architecture that fits.
* **Grow leaders:** Mentor senior engineers and develop future tech leads.

**Your First 90 Days**

* **Days 1–30:** Learn our products, codebases, and infrastructure, and identify the biggest architectural risks and opportunities.
* **Days 31–60:** Lead a significant design decision from proposal to production and take a visible role in design reviews.
* **Days 61–90:** Introduce standards or patterns that teams adopt, and become the go-to technical authority on a core platform.

**Must Have**

* 6+ years in software engineering with clear ownership of architecture decisions
* Experience running a production system with 100,000+ users
* Proven track record of solving serious scale and performance bottlenecks
* Strong hands-on Node.js and React (MERN preferred) with TypeScript
* Solid cloud architecture experience on AWS, GCP, or Azure
* Background in healthcare, fintech, payments, insurance, or another high-security domain
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, API design, databases, and reliability
* Ability to explain and defend technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences

**Nice to Have**

* HIPAA/PHI, PCI-DSS, GDPR, or SOC 2 compliance experience
* Stripe, Braintree, Adyen, or tokenization experience
* High-availability, event-driven, or microservices systems
* Consultancy or product-studio experience across multiple clients
* Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)

**Why Techdome**

* **Independent and profitable:** No investor pressure. We play the long game.
* **Real influence:** Set engineering standards for an 80+ engineer team.
* **Fast path to production:** Your designs ship quickly and reach real users.
* **Global team:** Engineers across India, Dubai, and the US.

**Tech Lead / Solution Architect (Stream Lead)**

  

**Role:**

As a **Tech Lead / Solution Architect (Stream Lead)**, you will lead an engineering pod (stream) building features for an enterprise-grade SaaS platform in the data privacy, data governance and AI governance space. You will own the technical design of your stream within the clients architecture governance, break the backlog into deliverable work, and make sure every sprint ships production-ready, well-tested code. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines solution design, code and design reviews, and day-to-day guidance of a team of backend, data/AI, frontend and quality engineers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the technical design and solution architecture for your stream, aligned with the clients architecture governance, standards and review processes.
* Break down epics and features into well-defined user stories and technical tasks, and provide reliable effort estimates.
* Lead sprint planning and execution for the pod, making sure committed scope is delivered on time and meets the definition of done.
* Conduct code and design reviews across backend (Java/Spring Boot, Python), frontend (Angular) and integration components, enforcing quality, security and performance standards.
* Design scalable microservices, REST APIs and integration patterns, including connectors to SaaS, cloud, data and AI platforms.
* Drive release readiness: test coverage, CI/CD quality gates, documentation & deployment sign-off.
* Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies and blockers, and escalate early to the Engineering Manager.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, UX designers and QA to translate requirements into technical solutions.

**What Youll Bring:**

* Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2–3 years as a Tech Lead or Solution Architect.
* Proven track record of leading agile teams that deliver enterprise SaaS products or platforms.
* Strong hands-on background in Java/Spring Boot and/or Python, with the ability to review full-stack code.

**Mandatory Skills:**

* Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot and microservices architecture, with working knowledge of Python.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, event-driven integrations and data models for distributed systems.
* Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, Docker and Kubernetes.
* Working knowledge of Angular and TypeScript, enough to review frontend designs and code.
* Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and release management.
* Exp. with Agile/Scrum, backlog refinement and estimation, using tools such as Jira & Confluence.
* Good understanding of secure coding, OAuth2/SSO and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience building connectors or integrations with SaaS, cloud or data platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Snowflake, Databricks).
* Exposure to GenAI/LLM-based applications and agentic AI frameworks.
* Domain knowledge of data privacy, data governance, security or AI governance products.
* Cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

  

**Why join us?**

* Build enterprise-grade products in data privacy, AI governance that are used worldwide.
* Work hands-on technologies across GenAI, agentic AI, cloud (AWS and Azure), full-stack engineering.
* Learn from experienced architects, engineering leaders through mentorship, design reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Grow your career with twice-yearly appraisals, certification support and a promote-from-within culture.
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits as a full-time employee.
* Be part of an award-winning, CMMI Level 3 appraised data and AI company.

988c781f26be.description:
JD — Senior Product & Brand Designer

Senior Product & Brand Designer

Reports to: Director of Growth Marketing (marketing work) and Director of AI Products & Solutions (product work)

100% REMOTE — WORK FROM HOME (INDIA)

REQUIRED WORKING HOURS: 5:30 P.M. – 2:30 A.M. IST

This role supports our US business. Candidates must be available for the full US Central Time workday, every working day. The India schedule moves by one hour when the US switches between daylight and standard time. Immediate joiners and candidates with notice periods under 30 days get priority.

About the Company

Revenue Optics is a US-based commercial growth firm. We help private equity-backed B2B distributors and industrial companies build stronger revenue engines. We work directly with CEOs, chief revenue officers, commercial leaders and private equity operating partners at companies with $200 million to more than $10 billion in annual revenue.

* Sales transformation: building and scaling proactive inside sales organizations.
* Talent solutions: recruiting high-impact sales and commercial leadership talent.
* Pricing and revenue growth management: finding and capturing margin and revenue opportunities.
* Data, analytics and AI: uncovering revenue opportunities and deploying AI-enabled commercial solutions.

The firm is led by Ali Hasham, a 26-year distribution operator who scaled inside sales from 0 to 90+ reps across 400+ branches at WESCO, TruckPro and Motion Industries.

About the Role

This is a senior, hands-on design role that sits across two teams: Marketing and AI Products & Solutions. About 60% of your time goes to marketing: sales decks, campaign assets, social graphics and long-form reports for senior executives. The other 40% goes to AI Products & Solutions: designing dashboards, interfaces and prototypes for our AI products.

What ties both together is one skill: taking complex ideas, data and workflows and making them obvious to the person looking at them, whether that is a CRO reading a slide or a pricing manager using a dashboard.

We build a lot with AI and keep optimizing on top of it. Designers who build well with AI are highly preferred: people who use it to create templates, systems and workflows so production scales and more of their time goes to work that needs real design judgment.

You'll work directly with the Director of Growth Marketing and the Director of AI Products & Solutions. Briefs will give you the content and a high-level direction; we rely on your judgment to decide how best to show it.

Responsibilities

Visual storytelling (both teams)

* Turn complex ideas, research, statistics, frameworks and workflows into visuals that make the key message obvious in seconds.
* Decide what the single most important point is on every slide, page, post or screen, and design so the user can't miss it.
* Design charts, tables, diagrams and data-dense views that are easy to read, and check every figure against the source.

Product design (AI Products & Solutions)

* Design dashboards, screens and interfaces for our AI products, from understanding the user and the business goal to flows, wireframes, prototypes and final UI.
* Apply strong UX fundamentals: user journeys, information architecture, interaction design, usability and responsive layouts.
* Translate business requirements into practical, usable solutions, and push back when a requirement will hurt the user.
* Build high-fidelity designs, interactive prototypes and reusable components in Figma.
* Use AI prototyping tools (Lovable, Bolt or similar) to validate ideas quickly before engineering builds them.
* Hand off clean, build-ready specs to engineers, stay close during development, and resolve issues so the shipped product matches the design.

Sales decks and collateral (Marketing)

* Own our sales decks: design new decks on request and keep existing decks current as our services, results and team change.
* Build and maintain PowerPoint master templates, layouts and slide libraries that the sales team can edit without breaking the design.
* Design one-pagers, case studies, capability sheets and proposals.

Social, campaign and long-form (Marketing)

* Design LinkedIn graphics, carousels, banners and ad creatives for the company page and leadership profiles, in line with the content calendar.
* Create campaign assets for email, webinars, events, landing pages and the website.
* Design white papers, ebooks and reports using reusable layout templates, consistent from cover to last page.

AI-powered production

* Use AI tools where they help with concepting, image generation, layout variation, editing and production.
* Build reusable templates, prompt libraries and workflows (for example automated resizing, on-brand variations, faster deck and social builds) that make the whole team faster.
* Keep AI output on-brand and consistent across a series, and know when a custom design is the better choice.

Brand and product design systems

* Own the Revenue Optics brand system for marketing: color, typography, iconography, imagery, chart styles and layout.
* Build and maintain a separate design system for our AI products: components, patterns and data-dense UI built for software. It can draw on the brand but is designed for product use.
* Propose new visual directions and recurring formats that help us stand out while staying credible to a senior, conservative audience.
* Keep source files, templates, components and brand assets organized in our shared library, and tasks up to date in Asana.

Qualifications

6–9 years of design experience, including at least 2–3 years designing web or app interfaces that shipped, ideally dashboards, analytics tools or B2B software. You also have a strong record in executive, presentation or marketing design.

Required Skills

* Proven ability to present complex ideas and dense data in a format that drives the point home.
* Strong UI/UX fundamentals: user journeys, information architecture, interaction design, usability and responsive design.
* Advanced Figma: high-fidelity designs, interactive prototypes, reusable components and design systems.
* Experience handing designs off to engineers and working with them through development.
* Comfort using AI tools in design work. Candidates who build well with AI, with clear examples of how it improved their speed or output, are highly preferred.
* Advanced PowerPoint skills, including slide masters, layouts and editable templates.
* Strong typography, layout, visual hierarchy and data visualization.
* Close attention to detail: every figure and line of copy in a final file is correct and checked against the source.
* Ability to explain your design decisions clearly and take feedback well, including vague feedback.
* Good written and spoken English for working with a US-based team.
* Highly organized and reliable: you balance requests from two teams, manage several projects at once and flag priority conflicts early.

Nice to Have

* End-to-end product design experience, including iterating on features based on user behaviour and product performance.
* Experience building AI workflows or automations for design production.
* Experience building or maintaining design systems, for a brand, a software product or both.
* Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop or other professional design tools.
* Motion design or animation for social content and product demos.
* Exposure to industrial, manufacturing, distribution, financial or private equity audiences.

Pay: ₹1,800,000.00 - ₹2,400,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

EazyML, recognized by Gartner, EazyML specializes in Responsible AI. Our solutions facilitate proactive compliance and sustainable automation, and the company is associated with breakthrough startups like Amelia.ai.

  

This is a full-time Remote role for an experienced Senior Platform Architect — Microsoft Fabric who enjoys solving complex data problems and takes ownership from design through delivery. You can work from home (anywhere in INDIA, job location is in India).

Experience Level: Senior (10+ years overall, 2+ years hands-on with Microsoft Fabric) DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DON'T HAVE AT LEAST 8+ YEARS OF EXPERIENCE. THIS IS A SENIOR POSITION

  

This role is ideal for someone who can build scalable data pipelines on Microsoft Azure Fabric, leverage AI to improve engineering productivity, and work closely with business and technical stakeholders.

  

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Architect with strong DevOps expertise to design, implement, and operationalize our Microsoft Fabric data platform. You'll own the architecture of our unified data estate — spanning OneLake, Data Factory pipelines, Synapse Data Engineering, Power BI, and Real-Time Analytics — while building the CI/CD, governance, and automation backbone that lets our data teams ship reliably and securely. This is a hands-on architecture role: you'll set technical direction and also build it yourself.

  

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or Cloud Data Platform development.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure Data Platform technologies.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric in enterprise implementations.
* Strong expertise in SQL, PySpark, Python, and Spark optimization.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric components including OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory, Power BI, and Real-Time Intelligence.
* Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure DevOps, GitHub, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong knowledge of dimensional data modeling, ETL/ELT architecture, and data governance.

  

What You'll Do

* Design and own the end-to-end architecture for Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake data lake structure, workspace and capacity strategy, domain/workspace segregation, and medallion (bronze/silver/gold) layering.
* Define and implement DevOps practices for Fabric: Git integration, deployment pipelines, environment promotion (dev/test/prod), and infrastructure-as-code for Fabric items (lakehouses, warehouses, notebooks, pipelines, semantic models).
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) for Fabric artifacts, including automated testing, validation, and rollback strategies.
* Architect and enforce governance, security, and access controls across Fabric — workspace roles, OneLake data access policies, sensitivity labels, row-level security, and integration with Microsoft Purview.
* Partner with data engineers, analysts, and platform teams to standardize development patterns, reusable templates, and best practices across Fabric workloads (Data Factory, Data Engineering/Spark, Data Warehouse, Real-Time Intelligence, Power BI).
* Lead migration efforts from legacy platforms (Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, on-prem SSIS/SQL Server, or other cloud data warehouses) onto Microsoft Fabric.
* Mentor engineering teams on Fabric architecture patterns, DevOps practices, and operational excellence.

Roles & Responsibilities: Technical Leadership

* Lead the end-to-end implementation of Microsoft Fabric solutions across enterprise programs.
* Define technical architecture, engineering standards, and best practices for Microsoft Fabric adoption.
* Provide technical leadership to a team of data engineers and developers.
* Review solution designs, code, and deployment strategies to ensure quality and scalability.

Microsoft Fabric Architecture

* Design and implement enterprise data platforms using Microsoft Fabric components including OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory, Real-Time Intelligence, Data Engineering, and Power BI.
* Architect scalable, cloud-native data solutions supporting analytics, AI, and business intelligence workloads.
* 3 + years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, or deep equivalent experience with Azure Synapse Analytics, Power BI, and Azure Data Factory with a clear path to Fabric.
* Strong command of OneLake, Lakehouse and Warehouse architecture, Delta Lake/Parquet formats, and medallion architecture design.

Data Engineering & Integration

* Design and develop robust ETL/ELT pipelines using Microsoft Fabric Data Factory and Spark Notebooks.
* Integrate structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data from cloud and on-premises systems.
* Implement data transformation, cleansing, validation, and orchestration processes.
* Optimize data ingestion strategies for performance and reliability.

Data Modeling & Analytics

* Design dimensional models, Lakehouse architectures, and enterprise data warehouses.
* Develop semantic models and datasets for Power BI reporting and self-service analytics.
* Collaborate with business teams to translate analytical requirements into scalable data solutions.

Performance Optimization

* Optimize Spark workloads, SQL Warehouse performance, and OneLake storage utilization.
* Implement partitioning, indexing, caching, and workload optimization strategies.
* Monitor platform performance and proactively resolve bottlenecks.

Security & Governance

* Implement enterprise security using Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, and Fabric workspace security.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, privacy, and regulatory standards.

DevOps & Automation

* Implement CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub.
* Automate deployment of Microsoft Fabric artifacts across Development, QA, UAT, and Production environments.
* Manage source control, release management, and deployment automation.

AI & Advanced Analytics

* Enable AI, Machine Learning, and Copilot capabilities within Microsoft Fabric.
* Support Data Science workloads using Spark, notebooks, and ML models.
* Collaborate with AI teams to operationalize predictive analytics and intelligent data solutions.

Production Support & Operations

* Lead production deployments and post-production support activities.
* Monitor platform health, troubleshoot incidents, and ensure SLA compliance.
* Implement disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity strategies.

Stakeholder Management

* Collaborate with enterprise architects, product owners, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
* Participate in architecture review boards and technical governance meetings.
* Communicate technical solutions and project status to senior leadership.

Team Leadership & Mentoring

* Mentor junior and senior engineers on Microsoft Fabric technologies and engineering best practices.
* Conduct code reviews, design reviews, and technical knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and foster engineering excellence.

  

Nice to Have

* Microsoft certifications: DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer), DP-203 (Azure Data Engineer), or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Experience with Power BI semantic model optimization and DirectLake mode.
* Familiarity with data mesh or domain-driven data architecture principles.
* Experience with Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Azure AI Services, or Microsoft Purview.
* Knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Strong communication, stakeholder manage

**This role is for one of our clients**

Industry: Software Development  
Company Name: EazyML

Seniority level: Mid-Senior Level

  

Experience: 10+ Years Overall (Minimum 8+ Years Required)  
Microsoft Fabric Experience: 2+ Years of Hands-on Experience  
Location: Remote – Anywhere in India  
Employment Type: Full-Time

We are looking for an experienced Lead Data Architect – Microsoft Fabric to design, build, and operationalise scalable enterprise data platforms on Microsoft Azure. This is a senior, hands-on architecture role requiring strong expertise in data engineering, cloud data platforms, DevOps, and Microsoft Fabric.

You will work closely with data engineers, analysts, enterprise architects, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver modern data solutions that support analytics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and business intelligence workloads.

Important: This is a senior-level position. Candidates must have at least 8 years of overall professional experience, with 10+ years preferred, and relevant hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric or equivalent Azure data platform technologies.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Enterprise Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise Microsoft Fabric solutions.
* Define technical architecture, engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices for platform adoption.
* Own the architecture of the unified data ecosystem, including OneLake structure, workspace strategy, capacity planning, and domain segregation.
* Establish medallion architecture patterns across Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers.
* Provide technical leadership to data engineers and developers, ensuring quality, scalability, and consistency.
* Review solution designs, code, and deployment strategies to ensure alignment with architectural standards.

### **2. Microsoft Fabric Platform Architecture**

* Design and implement enterprise data platforms using Microsoft Fabric components, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory, Data Engineering, Real-Time Intelligence, and Power BI.
* Architect scalable, cloud-native data solutions supporting analytics, AI, and business intelligence requirements.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of OneLake, Lakehouse and Warehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Parquet formats, and medallion architecture.
* Define workspace and capacity strategies, domain-level segregation, and platform design standards.
* Leverage Fabric capabilities to establish a unified, scalable, and secure enterprise data environment.

### **3. Data Engineering and Integration**

* Design and develop robust ETL/ELT pipelines using Microsoft Fabric Data Factory and Spark Notebooks.
* Integrate structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data from cloud-based and on-premises systems.
* Implement data ingestion, transformation, cleansing, validation, and orchestration processes.
* Optimise ingestion strategies to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Work with SQL, Python, PySpark, and Apache Spark to build and optimise data engineering solutions.

### **4. Data Modelling and Analytics**

* Design dimensional data models, Lakehouse architectures, and enterprise data warehouses.
* Develop semantic models and datasets to support Power BI reporting and self-service analytics.
* Translate business and analytical requirements into scalable data architecture and engineering solutions.
* Establish data modelling standards and reusable patterns across enterprise workloads.

### **5. DevOps, CI/CD and Automation**

* Define and implement DevOps practices for Microsoft Fabric, including Git integration, deployment pipelines, and environment promotion across Development, QA, UAT, and Production.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Automate deployment of Fabric artefacts, including Lakehouses, Warehouses, Notebooks, Pipelines, and Semantic Models.
* Implement automated testing, validation, release management, and rollback strategies.
* Establish infrastructure-as-code and source control practices for Fabric workloads.

### **6. Security, Governance and Compliance**

* Architect and enforce enterprise security and access controls across Microsoft Fabric.
* Implement workspace roles, OneLake data access policies, sensitivity labels, and row-level security.
* Work with Microsoft Entra ID, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and Microsoft Purview to establish governance frameworks.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Establish consistent data governance and access management practices.

### **7. Performance Optimisation**

* Optimise Spark workloads, SQL Warehouse performance, and OneLake storage utilisation.
* Implement partitioning, indexing, caching, and workload optimisation strategies.
* Monitor platform performance, identify bottlenecks, and proactively improve system efficiency.
* Ensure scalability, reliability, and efficient resource utilisation across data workloads.

### **8. Cloud Migration and Platform Modernisation**

* Lead migration initiatives from legacy data platforms, including Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, on-premises SSIS/SQL Server, and other cloud data warehouses, to Microsoft Fabric.
* Define migration strategies, architecture patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
* Ensure smooth integration, data consistency, and minimal disruption during platform transitions.

### **9. AI and Advanced Analytics**

* Enable AI, Machine Learning, and Copilot capabilities within Microsoft Fabric.
* Support data science workloads using Spark, notebooks, and machine learning models.
* Collaborate with AI teams to operationalise predictive analytics and intelligent data solutions.
* Leverage AI capabilities to improve engineering productivity and data platform efficiency.

### **10. Production Support and Stakeholder Management**

* Lead production deployments and post-deployment support activities.
* Monitor platform health, troubleshoot incidents, and ensure SLA compliance.
* Establish disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity strategies.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, product owners, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
* Participate in architecture review boards and technical governance meetings.
* Communicate technical solutions, implementation plans, and project status to senior leadership.

### **11. Team Leadership and Mentoring**

* Mentor data engineers and developers on Microsoft Fabric architecture and engineering best practices.
* Conduct code reviews, design reviews, and technical knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote engineering excellence.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**
--------------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or Cloud Data Platform development.
* Minimum 8+ years of overall professional experience is mandatory.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure Data Platform technologies.
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience implementing Microsoft Fabric in enterprise environments.
* Strong expertise in SQL, Python, PySpark, and Apache Spark optimisation.

* Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure DevOps, GitHub, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong understanding of dimensional data modelling, ETL/ELT architecture, and data governance.
* Proven experience designing scalable data platforms and leading enterprise-level data engineering initiatives.

**About Trellix**
  
Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense-grade protection at machine speed across on-premises, air-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state-sponsored attacks. At Trellix, we empower professionals at all career stages to expand their technical expertise, lead strategic initiatives, and make a tangible global impact. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI-driven cyber defense alongside an AI-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at https://trellix.com.

***Role Overview:***

We are looking for strategic, hands-on Security Engineer to drive end-to-end vulnerability management, governance, and risk-based prioritization across hybrid, cloud, and containerized environments in alignment with NIST SSDF, EU CRA, and IEC standards. The role focuses on engineering autonomous AI agents to automate asset discovery, finding validation, exploitability analysis, ticket orchestration, and zero-day response. Candidates will lead cross-functional remediation with IT and DevOps teams, streamline exception workflows, and deliver executive-level risk reporting and metrics.

**About Role:**

* Direct continuous asset discovery, vulnerability assessment, remediation verification, and executive reporting across hybrid cloud, container, and application ecosystems.
* Contextualize vulnerability severity (CVSS) using real-world threat intelligence (EPSS, CISA KEV) and business criticality. Spearhead rapid response protocols for critical zero-day vulnerabilities, implementing interim compensating controls and formal risk-acceptance workflows as required.
* Architect and deploy autonomous AI agents to automate asset discovery, CMDB reconciliation, false-positive elimination, exploitability analysis, intelligent ticket routing, SLA breach escalations, and executive reporting.
* Establish and enforce program governance, remediation SLAs, and exception management frameworks aligned with NIST SSDF, EU CRA, and IEC standards.
* Define, track, and present key performance indicators (scan coverage, MTTR, SLA adherence, and vulnerability aging) to senior leadership. Partner with and mentor IT Operations, DevOps, and Software Engineering teams to accelerate remediation and embed security-by-design practices.

**About You:**

* 5+ years in Information Security with a strong focus on Vulnerability Management, Application Security, or Cloud Security.
* Extensive hands-on expertise with industry-leading VM, CNAPP, and AppSec solutions—including **Tenable, Wiz**, Qualys, CrowdStrike, or Snyk—with proven ability to programmatically orchestrate scans, ingest telemetry, and validate remediation.
* Demonstrated experience designing and deploying autonomous AI agents and multi-step LLM workflows using frameworks such as **LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs** to automate discovery, reconciliation, and remediation pipelines.
* Proficiency in leveraging LLMs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures to correlate vulnerability data with source code repositories, asset metadata, and exploit intelligence to filter false positives and determine real-world exploitability.
* Strong proficiency in **Python** for developing production-grade security automation, custom integrations, and consuming or building REST and GraphQL APIs.
* Proven experience integrating security scanners with SOAR platforms, enterprise ticketing systems (**Jira, ServiceNow**), CMDBs, and collaboration platforms (**Slack, Microsoft Teams**) for automated ticket creation, routing, reminders, and SLA escalations.
* Deep command of CVSS, EPSS, and CISA KEV methodologies, with experience enriching vulnerability telemetry using threat feeds and business impact assessments.
* Comprehensive understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), hybrid enterprise networks, container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
* Working knowledge of **NIST SSDF, EU CRA, and IEC** regulatory frameworks, paired with the ability to build automated executive dashboards tracking MTTR, scan coverage, and SLA compliance.

We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.

We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

***Our Commitment to You:***

At Trellix, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.

Trellix conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. Trellix also does not require candidates to pay fees, purchase products or services, or process payments of any kind as part of the recruiting or hiring process. And Trellix will never keep any original work authorization documents that we may be required to review during the hiring process.

If you have questions or believe you may have encountered fraudulent activity related to Trellix recruiting, please contact us at **ethics@trellix.com**.

b340cae028a5.title: Senior Security Engineer (Any Programming)
b340cae028a5.description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a **Senior Software Security Engineer** to develop high-quality training and evaluation tasks for frontier AI coding models. You will transform real-world open-source vulnerabilities—including CVEs, security advisories, and bug reports—into Harbor-format audit-and-patch tasks across multiple programming languages.

This role combines software security research, vulnerability reproduction, benchmark development, automated testing, and technical review. The goal is to create realistic tasks that evaluate whether AI systems can identify, understand, exploit, and securely remediate software vulnerabilities without relying on superficial pattern matching or known patches.

**What does day-to-day look like**

* Source and analyze real-world vulnerabilities from CVEs, security advisories, bug reports, and open-source repositories.
* Classify vulnerabilities using the most specific applicable CWE and map them to relevant OWASP Top 10 categories where appropriate.
* Reproduce vulnerabilities and develop reliable proof-of-vulnerability tests.
* Build Harbor-format audit-and-patch tasks across languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, and Swift.
* Write realistic task instructions that describe the security issue without revealing the vulnerable code, exploit details, or expected fix.
* Create reproducible Docker-based environments with pinned dependencies and clear setup procedures.
* Harden verifiers against gaming, overfitting, test manipulation, and hardcoded solutions.
* Screen out tasks that can be solved by copying a well-known upstream patch without understanding the vulnerability.
* Review and score AI-generated patches and reasoning using clearly defined technical rubrics.
* Document vulnerability context, reproduction steps, expected behavior, patch requirements, test methodology, and review decisions.

**Requirements**

* **5+ years** of professional software engineering experience.
* Expert-level proficiency in **at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift.**
* Strong understanding of software security concepts, including CWE, CVE, and the OWASP Top 10.
* Ability to reproduce vulnerabilities and write proof-of-vulnerability tests.
* Hands-on experience with security tooling, including sanitizers, fuzzers, and static-analysis tools such as CodeQL or Semgrep.
* Strong proficiency with Git, Linux, Bash, and Docker.
* Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fully remote, research-oriented environment.

Benefits:

474486174e61.description:
**Job Summary**   

We are seeking a talented and experienced **Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer** with deep expertise in **Tableau, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern data modeling (dbt, Omni, or Looker Studio)** to join our team. In this role, you will lead critical business intelligence modernization initiatives, reverse-engineering complex reporting logic from legacy dashboards and rebuilding high-performance analytical data models to power executive decision-making.

As a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer, you will work closely with technical leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to modernize legacy BI environments.

You will be responsible for deconstructing legacy dashboard architectures, extracting embedded business rules and Level of Detail (LOD) calculations, and re-architecting those metrics into scalable SQL models and cloud semantic layers.

You will perform as a core data translator, bridging the gap between cloud data warehouses, semantic layers, and client-facing business teams.

  
  
**Qualification Experience**   

* Bachelors or masters degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, systems engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical discipline.
* At least 5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or analytics engineering.
* At least 4 years of hands-on experience using Tableau to design, maintain, and audit complex dashboards and calculated fields.
* Demonstrated experience with cloud data warehouses, specifically **Google BigQuery** and/or **Snowflake**.
* Proven experience delivering BI migration, dashboard refactoring, or semantic data modeling projects.

  
  
**Required Skills/Competencies**   

* **Advanced Tableau Engineering:** Deep understanding of complex Tableau calculations, parameters, table calculations, and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions ( FIXED , INCLUDE , EXCLUDE ), with the ability to unpack workbook logic.
* **Cloud Data Warehousing Advanced SQL:** Strong expertise in writing performant, modular SQL (CTEs, window functions) and structuring data within **Google BigQuery** and/or **Snowflake**.
* **Modern Transformations Modeling:** Hands-on experience with **dbt** for building curated data models and managing transformation workflows.
* **Semantic Layer Modern BI Tools:** Hands-on experience building semantic data models or curated topics in **Omni Analytics** or **Looker Studio** (formerly Google Data Studio) / Looker.
* **Data Validation Quality Assurance:** Rigorous approach to data reconciliation, checking data parity between legacy source reporting and modernized target models.
* **Communication Stakeholder Management:** Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (Full Professional / Advanced) to lead technical discussions, clarify metric definitions, and present solutions directly to stakeholders.
* **Ways of Working:** Self-motivated, proactive problem-solver comfortable working independently in an Agile sprint-based environment.

  
  
**Responsibilities**   

* **Reverse-Engineer Reporting Logic:** Audit and deconstruct legacy Tableau workbooks, deciphering nested formulas, calculated fields, and LOD expressions into clear business documentation.

**Job Summary**   

We're looking for a high-energy, relationship-driven Technical Recruiter who thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and is passionate about finding and closing top-tier engineering product talent. In this role, you'll own full-cycle recruiting for all technical roles, acting as a true partner to hiring managers and a champion of candidate experience. We have a strong foundation but lots of opportunity to build and experiment. If you enjoy iterating quickly, and making an impact at a company where talent is our greatest asset, we'd love to connect.

  
  
**Responsibilities**   
  
**Sourcing Pipeline Building**   

* Proactively source and engage passive technical candidates using various platforms (Linkedin Recruiter, Juicebox, etc).
* Build and maintain pipelines of top engineering and product talent to support both current and future hiring needs.
* Leverage creative and data-informed sourcing strategies to proactively uncover and engage a diverse pool of top-tier talent.
* Process Optimization: Embrace a mindset of continuous iteration, regularly evaluating and refining recruitment processes to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and candidate experience.
* Champion best practices while identifying opportunities through AI to streamline workflows and elevate hiring outcomes across the organization.

  
  
**Recruiting Candidate Management**   

* Own the end-to-end recruiting process for engineering product roles (e.g. software engineers, product managers, leadership roles).
* Act as a strategic partner to Engineering and Product leadership by driving kickoff and calibration meetings to define role requirements, align on candidate expectations, and architect effective interview strategies laying the foundation for successful technical hiring.

* Conduct in-depth interviews to assess technical and cultural fit, present qualified candidates to hiring managers, and facilitate a seamless interview process.
* Communicate our mission, values, and growth story to inspire and attract top technical talent.
* Ensure a high-quality candidate experience with timely updates, transparent feedback, and thoughtful communication.
* Track pipeline activity and maintain accurate records in our ATS (Greenhouse experience preferred).
* Report on key hiring metrics to help improve process efficiency and transparency.

  
  
**Collaboration Onboarding Support**   

* Partner with various departments to ensure smooth transitions from offer to onboarding.
* Assist with coordinating new hire onboarding activities specific to engineering product roles.

  
  
**What You'll Bring**   

* 6+ years of experience in technical recruiting, with a strong focus on engineering product roles
* Previous experience working in a hyper growth SaaS company (required)
* Working knowledge of ATS platforms (Greenhouse preferred) and sourcing tools
* Proactive Ownership: Takes initiative without waiting to be asked, anticipates needs, and drives action
* Influence Persuasion: Builds alignment and momentum across stakeholders to move processes ahead
* Highly Organized Efficient: Strong time management skills and the ability to juggle multiple open roles, hiring processes, and competing priorities without dropping the ball
* Excellent Communicator Relationship-Builder: Builds trust and credibility with candidates and stakeholders; ensures a high-touch, thoughtful experience throughout the hiring journey
* Self-Motivated Adaptable: Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments; operates with initiative and flexibility even as priorities shift and needs evolve
* Candidates must be located in the Eastern Time Zone.

**Role Overview:**

Could you be our next  **OIPA System Administration Lead**  Globe Life is looking for a  **OIPA System Administration Lead**  to join the team!

  

In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing Release Management and Environment/System Administration functions within the Policy Administration System (PAS) program. You will lead and mentor a team of Release Managers and System Administrators, set standards for deployment and environment governance, and serve as the primary escalation point for release readiness, infrastructure stability, patch compliance, and SDLC adherence across all OIPA environments. This role reports to the Director of IT Application Development.

  

**This is a remote / work-from-home position.**

  

**What You Will Do:**

  

* Manage, coach, and evaluate PAS Release Management and System Administration team members, including conducting performance appraisals and providing ongoing mentoring and professional development guidance.
* Assign work, set priorities, and monitor workloads across both functional areas.

* Establish standards and guiding principles for the release management process across all strategic in-flight PAS initiatives.
* Coordinate with enterprise change control processes and attend weekly production Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings.
* Review and approve change control documentation for migrations to each environment, assign version tracking, and maintain a complete audit trail via the enterprise ticketing system.
* Track production incidents and create required emergency change control documentation for off-cycle migrations; close incidents after verifying successful resolution.
* Coordinate PAS configuration and BPM deployment activities, including IVS cross-track deployments and the copying of tables between environments.
* Maintain the release calendar in partnership with Business and Technology leads for all major and minor release windows.
* Define guidelines for assessing deployment readiness and coordinate post-deployment validation and verification testing.
* Track release-related risks, issues, and dependencies across in-flight projects.
* Maintain communications and distribution lists to coordinate releases across legacy and ancillary applications.
* Provide direction to resources performing configuration migrations via Oracle Rules Palette (OIRP).
* Manage PAS System Administration resources across multiple data centers and monitor OIPA Application and Database Servers to ensure optimal performance.
* Review daily environment health checks and resolve performance or capacity concerns.
* Coordinate database and application server tuning, including recommendations for clustering, CPU, memory, and thread pool configuration.
* Coordinate new environment builds, complex deployments, migrations, and OIPA major and minor product upgrades.
* Coordinate the application of Oracle Exa patches, YUM updates, OIPA base code updates, and OIRP updates.
* Attend weekly vulnerability review sessions and coordinate timely remediation of identified vulnerabilities; act as the primary point of contact for PAS Information Security exceptions.
* Review SSL certificate status and coordinate replacements prior to expiration.
* Act as the primary point of contact for Oracle ASR hardware monitoring, Service Express, and My Oracle Support access.
* Maintain PAS and BPM ticket categories, resource assignments, and on-call resource listings in Cherwell.
* Work closely with internal OIPA Configuration teams and Oracle Development to manage OIPA Service Requests.

  
   

**What You Can Bring:**

  

* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Actuarial Science, Mathematics, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum 7 years of experience in IT application development or operations roles.

* Experience with Oracle Linux system administration and WebLogic administration.
* Experience with Oracle System Administration Tools including OEM, Admin Server, and Data Guard.
* Experience with OIPA Database and Application upgrades and OIPA Release Management.
* Experience with database backup tools such as Rubrik and RMAN.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable a cross-functional technical team.
* Strong understanding of IT SDLC processes and Agile project methodologies.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities under pressure while ensuring environments meet established SLAs.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and business audiences.
* Proficiency with enterprise ticketing systems such as Cherwell or ServiceNow.
* Familiarity with Oracle Insurance Policy Administration (OIPA) and Oracle Insurance Rules Palette (OIRP).
* Experience with Oracle Exalogic and Exadata is a plus.
* Experience with Oracle Admin Server and the OIPA nightly Cycle is a plus.
* OIPA implementation experience for multiple clients is a plus.
* Knowledge of Oracle IVS, Oracle SOA, MuleSoft, and BPM is a plus.
* Knowledge of AWS and Oracle OCI cloud computing is a plus.
* Working knowledge of insurance life and health products across individual, group, and worksite markets is a plus.

  

**Applicable To All Employees of Globe Life Family of Companies:**

**How Globe Life Will Support You:**

Looking to continue your career in an environment that values your contribution and invests in your growth Weve curated a benefits package that helps to ensure that you don t just work, but thrive at Globe Life:

76ef59050c57.skills: Coso, Business process, Information technology, Digital, Ai Solutions, PMO management, Equity, Gitlab
76ef59050c57.description:
**Job Summary**   

As Manager, SOX PMO - Business Process, you'll lead Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance for assigned business processes as part of GitLab's second line. This is advisory work, not repeatable testing: you'll deeply understand how processes work, evaluate risks as the business changes, and help control owners design and remediate controls that hold up to audit. Judgment matters more than procedure. You'll form well-supported conclusions, align with control owners and Internal Audit, and defend positions to external auditors. GitLab already uses AI extensively, and the next phase brings AI agents into our SOX processes. You'll help teams adopt them with confidence, finding creative ways to enable new ways of working while maintaining compliance. You'll also partner with the information technology (IT) SOX PMO on readiness for new systems and applications. This role reports to the Senior Director, SOX PMO, within the Chief Accounting Officers organization.

  
  
**Responsibilities**   

* Lead SOX compliance for assigned business processes as the second-line subject matter expert, advising control owners who own and operate the controls. Deeply understand each process, its systems and data flows, and resolve open questions and assumptions early.
* Monitor risks from new and changing processes, products, and systems. Help control owners design, strengthen, or right-size controls, and contribute to the annual SOX risk assessment and scoping.
* Evaluate control deficiencies individually and in aggregate, identify root causes, and prepare well-supported severity assessments. Work with management to develop, implement, and monitor remediation plans.
* Prepare auditor-ready technical memos on sampling methodology, scoping, and control rationalization, using independent analysis and sound conclusions. Prepare reports and presentations on SOX compliance status for leadership.
* Lead business walkthroughs and stakeholder meetings, and coordinate with Internal Audit and external auditors throughout the audit. Anticipate questions, support positions with data and judgment, and escalate risks and auditor comments promptly with a recommended path forward.
* Advise on controls for AI-enabled processes and processes that use AI agents. Find opportunities to automate SOX work using AI tools, and validate their output.
* Partner with the IT SOX PMO to assess new systems and controls, including application controls and key reports.
* Develop and maintain accurate process narratives, flowcharts, and risk and control matrices as processes change. Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Legal, Human Resources, Sales, Engineering, and IT leaders to help them design and maintain effective business controls.

  
  
**What You'll Bring**   

* Hands-on SOX and internal controls experience in control design, remediation, and deficiency evaluation, beyond testing alone. Experience in the software or technology industry is required; SOX PMO, Big Four risk advisory, or assurance experience is a strong plus.
* A bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; an active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential (strongly preferred) or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) credential.
* A strong understanding of SOX requirements and internal control frameworks, such as the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO) framework.
* Professional judgment and skepticism: verifying facts against source documents, testing the reasonableness of data and conclusions, and recognizing missing information.
* A track record of independently solving ambiguous, novel problems, from defining an approach through overcoming obstacles and driving resolution. Curiosity to understand how processes actually work and keep learning as the business changes.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including concise, accurate, auditor-ready memos and actionable recommendations. Confidence partnering with senior stakeholders and external auditors, including working through pushback.
* A practical, innovative approach to helping the business adopt new technologies, products, and ways of working while maintaining compliance. Experience using AI tools to improve efficiency and validating their output.
* Experience with usage-based billing or AuditBoard is a plus.

  
  
**About the team**   

The SOX PMO is part of the Chief Accounting Officers organization. In this role, you'll advise business control owners and partner with the IT SOX PMO, Internal Audit, and external auditors to keep GitLab compliant as processes, systems, and AI use evolve. GitLab is an all-remote company, with flexibility to work from home or wherever you're most productive. You'll need to be available to collaborate with teammates during core US Pacific (PT) and Eastern (ET) business hours.

* Experience in ICT system design or implementation, particularly metering, billing, collection, and CRM systems.
* Proven expertise in project management, contract management, stakeholder coordination, and reporting.
* Demonstrated experience in large-scale power distribution or AMR/AMI/Smart Metering projects meeting the investment criteria below.

  

**Mandatory Project Experience**

39d384ca1203.description:
**Design it, build it, and own it in production.**

Anyone can draw a system diagram. What sets great architects apart is what happens after: whether the design holds when traffic grows tenfold, whether security survives a real audit, and whether teams can still build on it two years later.

Techdome designs and runs production-grade platforms in FinTech, Healthcare, AI, SaaS, and more, including our own products  **JustInterview.ai**  (AI hiring) and  **Sparrow**  (API testing). Our systems handle sensitive patient data and real financial transactions at scale. We re looking for a hands-on Software Architect to shape how these platforms are built, write code alongside the team, and stay accountable for how they perform in production.

**What You ll Do**

* **Own the architecture:**  System design, APIs, data models, security, scalability, observability, and cloud cost.
* **Build security in:**  Design PHI and payment flows with compliance part of the architecture, not a retrofit.
* **Drive cloud-native delivery:**  MERN platforms on AWS/GCP/Azure with Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC, and secrets management.
* **Make the hard calls:**  Monolith vs. microservices, event-driven design, integrations, build vs. buy. Decide, document, and stand behind it.
* **Own reliability:**  Uptime, latency, and throughput as usage grows; lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
* **Set the standard:**  Reference architectures, reusable patterns, and practical engineering guidelines.
* **Stay hands-on:**  Write code, run design reviews, and review PRs every week.
* **Think like the client:**  Translate business goals and constraints into architecture that fits.
* **Grow leaders:**  Mentor senior engineers and develop future tech leads.

**Your First 90 Days**

* **Days 1-30:**  Learn our products, codebases, and infrastructure, and identify the biggest architectural risks and opportunities.
* **Days 31-60:**  Lead a significant design decision from proposal to production and take a visible role in design reviews.
* **Days 61-90:**  Introduce standards or patterns that teams adopt, and become the go-to technical authority on a core platform.

**Must Have**

* 6+ years in software engineering with clear ownership of architecture decisions
* Experience running a production system with 100,000+ users
* Proven track record of solving serious scale and performance bottlenecks

**Number of Openings: 2**  
**Job Type: Full-Time**

**Location: Bangalore / Chennai / Hyderabad**  
**Shift Timing: 5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Mainframe z/OS System Programmer / Administrator** to join our Core Mainframe Infrastructure Services team.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in IBM z/OS system administration, L3 production support, SMP/E, JES3, Parallel Sysplex, and mainframe infrastructure management.

The role involves handling complex technical escalations, operating system upgrades, system performance optimization, disaster recovery, and high-availability infrastructure across mission-critical IBM Z environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide L3 support for complex IBM z/OS production incidents and infrastructure issues.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for system abends, system crashes, wait states, and performance issues.
* Manage z/OS operating system installation, maintenance, upgrades, and migration activities.
* Work on z/OS 3.1 to z/OS 3.2 migration and system upgrade projects.
* Manage SMP/E activities, including PTFs, APARs, software installation, and maintenance.
* Administer JES3 environments, spool management, batch processing, and job scheduling.
* Manage MVS console operations, system alerts, message routing, and automation.
* Maintain PARMLIB, PROCLIB, system configurations, and system parameters.
* Support Parallel Sysplex, Coupling Facility (CF), and CFRM policies.
* Manage Copy Services Manager (CSM), Metro Mirror, Global Mirror, and HyperSwap.
* Handle disaster recovery (DR) planning, testing, and execution.
* Provide L3 support for CA View, Flasher, and other mainframe tools.
* Collaborate with storage, network, automation, and application teams.
* Mentor L1/L2 support teams and drive continuous infrastructure improvements.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong experience in IBM z/OS System Administration and Mainframe Infrastructure.
* Hands-on experience with SMP/E, z/OSMF, and z/OS software installation and upgrades.
* Strong knowledge of JES2/JES3, preferably hands-on JES3 administration.
* Experience with Parallel Sysplex, CFRM policies, and Coupling Facility.
* Good knowledge of RACF, TSO, REXX, CLIST, and JCL.
* Experience with USS (UNIX System Services).
* Knowledge of IOCP/HCD, PARMLIB, PROCLIB, and WLM.
* Experience with VTAM, TCP/IP, FTP, and SFTP.
* Hands-on experience with IPCS dump analysis and system diagnostics.
* Experience with Copy Services Manager (CSM), HyperSwap, and storage replication.
* Knowledge of CA View, Flasher, and other mainframe ISV products.
* Experience in production support and handling critical incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with JES3 to JES2 migration.
* Knowledge of IBM Db2, IMS, CICS, and IBM MQ.
* Exposure to Ansible for z/OS, z/OSMF workflows, and Git-based source management.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.

b44c01fcd5c2.title: Site Reliability Engineer (Night Shift, 1:30am To 10:30am IST)
b44c01fcd5c2.skills: Microsoft Azure, Architecture, Apache, Cloud, Development, Reliability, AWS, Cloud Platform
b44c01fcd5c2.description:
**Job Summary**   

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a growing team that partners closely with Product Engineering, Security, and Support. We are responsible for the reliability, deployment, and continuous operation of the Ivanti Cloud services. We need your help to take our existing platform to the next level with observability, release automation, chaos engineering, and more.

The SRE role is a blend of infrastructure, networking, operating systems, automation, development, and application administration. It is a hands-on technical position in a fast-paced atmosphere. The ideal candidate has prior experience managing cloud-based SaaS applications and strives to solve traditional operations problems through automation and software. More so, the candidate must possess a high standard of excellence, have a strong customer focus, and is capable of technical deep dives into code, app servers, databases, load balancers, operating systems, and networks.

  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**   

* Work Monday to Friday from 1:30 AM to 10:30 AM IST, including lunch)
* Deploying, managing, and securing Ivanti s production Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environments in AWS and Azure
* Working with geographically dispersed, cross-departmental teams to solve difficult problems
* Automating common and repetitive tasks
* Write documentation and training material
* Train other colleagues.
* Participate in on-call rotations for 24x7 coverage (follow-the-sun model) for incident response, issue triage, and problem resolution

  
  
**To Be Successful in The Role, You Will Have**   

* A BSc in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 3+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Proficiency with Python and experience with one of the following languages:
  + Java
  + Golang
  + C#
* Proficiency working with Bash or PowerShell programmatically
* Familiarity with public cloud platforms (AWS or Azure preferred)
* Experience troubleshooting Java and .NET applications
* Experience troubleshooting network and storage infrastructure issues
* Experience working with Windows.
* Experience working with one or more: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, or similar
* Ability to configure and fine tune at least one: HA Proxy, Apache, Nginx, IIS, or similar
* Ability to configure: New Relic, DataDog, Splunk, or similar monitoring tools
* Familiarity with container orchestration technologies (AWS EKS or Azure AKS preferred)
* Experience with deployment pipeline tools such as Ansible, Jenkins, and/or GitHub Actions
* Proficiency working and developing Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* A desire to adopt and implement emergent technologies and best practices
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English for the purposes of global collaboration

  
  
**Nice-to-haves**   

* Prior experience as a Site Reliability Engineer or DevOps Engineer
* Certificates in one or more of the following categories, or demonstrated certificate-equivalent knowledge:
  + Cloud Development and architecture
  + Kubernetes Administration
  + Software engineering disciplines

8c5f7aa5b44d.description:
Were looking for thoughtful, full-stack engineers who enjoy owning problems end to end, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex technical challenges for products that millions of developers rely on every day. AI is a foundational part of how we build, so we value engineers who are excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI-assisted workflows while continuing to apply strong engineering fundamentals. As an engineer at Netlify, you ll work alongside experienced engineers who care about building great software, sharing knowledge, and helping one another grow. We believe the best engineering happens when talented people are trusted to solve difficult problems together, share what theyre learning, and create space for different perspectives to shape better solutions.

With our team, youll have real ownership from day one - not a tiny slice of a massive codebase. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, shape technical direction, and move quickly while collaborating closely with Product and Design.

  
   
  **What Youll Do**    

* Use your expertise in full-stack development (Our stack is TypeScript/JavaScript, React, Ruby, and Go) to ship reliable, scalable, performant code across our product suite.
* Build and maintain user-facing features, product APIs, and platform capabilities that scale to support millions of developers worldwide and lead projects from conception to delivery
* Apply strong engineering fundamentals, including testing, documentation, observability, and performance optimization, while thoughtfully incorporating AI-assisted development tools to accelerate prototyping, experimentation, and delivery.
* Navigate ambiguity with curiosity, contributing to both early-stage prototypes and production-ready applications that directly improve the developer experience and business outcomes.
* Practice proactive async communication and create visibility across projects by documenting your workflows and decision-making clearly.
* Participate in code reviews, on-call rotations, and continuous improvement efforts to reduce technical debt and maintain high engineering standards.
* Collaborate regularly with Engineering, Product, Design, and cross-functional teammates to design and implement experiences that help developers build faster and more effectively.
* Partner with teammates to share knowledge, mentor others through collaboration, and contribute to a thoughtful, inclusive engineering culture where continuous learning is encouraged.

  
   
  **What Youll Bring**    

* Demonstrated engineering proficiency with a curiosity for building with new technologies
* Strong full-stack expertise, with experience developing and maintaining production-quality software in modern full-stack environments. Required familiarity with one of the following: TypeScript and JavaScript, Go or Ruby for backend services and API development. Broader familiarity preferred.
* Extensive production experience delivering features and services that serve large user bases.
* Experience writing high-quality, testable code thats reliable and maintainable over time.
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, GPT-based agents, or similar technologies) to build applications, improve engineering workflows, or accelerate software development, along with good judgment about when and how to apply them effectively.
* Critical thinking abilities and a solution-oriented approach to complex technical challenges.
* Ability to participate in an on-call rotation after onboarding, responding primarily to scaling and reliability incidents using established runbooks.
* A collaborative approach to problem-solving with curiosity about how your work supports teammates, users, and broader company goals.
* Growth mindset and openness to learning new tools, technologies, and best practices.
* Passion for working in a collaborative environment with teammates across distributed locations, and strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous, remote-first environments.

  
   
  **This Role is a Great Fit If**    

* Youre energized by building products and platform capabilities that help millions of developers create, deploy, and scale applications.
* You see ambiguity as a creative opportunity and enjoy solving problems where there isnt always a predefined path forward.
* You see AI as a multiplier for your engineering skills - not a shortcut - and can thoughtfully articulate where it adds value, where it doesnt, and how you use it responsibly.
* You enjoy owning problems from end to end and are motivated by opportunities to make meaningful technical and product decisions.
* Comfort working autonomously and making decisions within a distributed, async, remote-first team.
* Youre excited by new tools, challenges, and opportunities to grow, even when they feel a little uncomfortable at first.
* You value curiosity, continuous learning, and creating an environment where teammates can learn from one another and do their best work.
* You want to work on a fully remote team that believes in autonomy, transparency, inclusion, and building a better web, together.

4587368f758f.description:
### Job Summary

Job Title: Vulnerability Management Engineer (AI Automation)

### Role Overview

We are looking for strategic, hands-on Security Engineer to drive end-to-end vulnerability management, governance, and risk-based prioritization across hybrid, cloud, and containerized environments in alignment with NIST SSDF, EU CRA, and IEC standards. The role focuses on engineering autonomous AI agents to automate asset discovery, finding validation, exploitability analysis, ticket orchestration, and zero-day response. Candidates will lead cross-functional remediation with IT and DevOps teams, streamline exception workflows, and deliver executive-level risk reporting and metrics.

### About Role

* Direct continuous asset discovery, vulnerability assessment, remediation verification, and executive reporting across hybrid cloud, container, and application ecosystems.
* Contextualize vulnerability severity (CVSS) using real-world threat intelligence (EPSS, CISA KEV) and business criticality. Spearhead rapid response protocols for critical zero-day vulnerabilities, implementing interim compensating controls and formal risk-acceptance workflows as required.
* Architect and deploy autonomous AI agents to automate asset discovery, CMDB reconciliation, false-positive elimination, exploitability analysis, intelligent ticket routing, SLA breach escalations, and executive reporting.
* Establish and enforce program governance, remediation SLAs, and exception management frameworks aligned with NIST SSDF, EU CRA, and IEC standards.
* Define, track, and present key performance indicators (scan coverage, MTTR, SLA adherence, and vulnerability aging) to senior leadership. Partner with and mentor IT Operations, DevOps, and Software Engineering teams to accelerate remediation and embed security-by-design practices.

### About You

* 5+ years in Information Security with a strong focus on Vulnerability Management, Application Security, or Cloud Security.
* Extensive hands-on expertise with industry-leading VM, CNAPP, and AppSec solutions-including Tenable, Wiz, Qualys, CrowdStrike, or Snyk-with proven ability to programmatically orchestrate scans, ingest telemetry, and validate remediation.
* Demonstrated experience designing and deploying autonomous AI agents and multi-step LLM workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs to automate discovery, reconciliation, and remediation pipelines.
* Proficiency in leveraging LLMs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures to correlate vulnerability data with source code repositories, asset metadata, and exploit intelligence to filter false positives and determine real-world exploitability.
* Strong proficiency in Python for developing production-grade security automation, custom integrations, and consuming or building REST and GraphQL APIs.
* Proven experience integrating security scanners with SOAR platforms, enterprise ticketing systems (Jira, ServiceNow), CMDBs, and collaboration platforms (Slack, Microsoft Teams) for automated ticket creation, routing, reminders, and SLA escalations.
* Deep command of CVSS, EPSS, and CISA KEV methodologies, with experience enriching vulnerability telemetry using threat feeds and business impact assessments.
* Comprehensive understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), hybrid enterprise networks, container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
* Working knowledge of NIST SSDF, EU CRA, and IEC regulatory frameworks, paired with the ability to build automated executive dashboards tracking MTTR, scan coverage, and SLA compliance.
